title: •Death Star Sentry
caption: •Death Star Sentry (V)
game_text: Plays on table. Opponent must first use X Force to deploy a non-unique card (except a Jawa) to a location, where X = the number of copies of that card at that location.
lore: Death Star troopers on sentry duty observe and direct incoming starships and monitor other critical sites. They perform sensor scans for life forms and weapons.

notes: Slip banner is DEFENSIVE SHIELD (printed card is an Effect). Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright year 1995 (Premiere), not legible. Modern remake is the Virtual Shields card (VSh-D-deathstarsentry-pre.gif, 350 px) — used as modern; VD-D-auselessgesturedeathstarsentry.gif (745) is a combo card, not downloaded.
